sources.title: Oracle Form 10-Q for quarter ended August 31, 2026
Oracle Announces Q1 Results Driven by Triple Digit Growth in Cloud Infrastructure Revenues, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1
Oracle Form 8-K: Larry Ellison cancels stock-sale plan

claims.text: Oracle supplies enterprise databases, cloud infrastructure, business applications, hardware, and services. Its NYSE common-stock ticker is ORCL.

FY2026 reportable businesses are cloud and software, hardware, and services. Subscription and consumption cloud revenue coexist with software licenses and support; these streams have different revenue-recognition patterns.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Our Businesses; Note 1, revenue recognition

claims.text: OCI supplies infrastructure; Oracle Database supports enterprise data; Fusion serves ERP, HCM, and customer workflows; NetSuite targets smaller organizations; Oracle Health serves healthcare.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Oracle Applications and Infrastructure Technologies

claims.text: Oracle serves enterprises and government across industries. Cloud-infrastructure demand and application renewals should be assessed separately; this packet does not quantify customer concentration.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Cloud and Software Business; Sales and Marketing

claims.text: Interpretation: cloud expansion couples software demand to datacenter construction, power, and component supply. Capacity delivery and financing are therefore operating constraints, not merely accounting details.

evidence.locator: Remaining Performance Obligations; Safe Harbor risk factors

claims.text: Oracle names Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Salesforce, SAP, and other vendors among competitors across its offerings. This broad list does not mean every named company competes in every product.

Interpretation: embedded databases and integrated applications may make migration costly. That hypothesis requires renewal and customer evidence; the annual report also describes intense competition and customer demand for lower complexity.
Management guided FY2027 revenue to at least USD 90,000 million and non-GAAP EPS to USD 8.10 on September 10. These are forecasts dependent on execution and demand, not reported results.
FY2027 Q1 ended August 31, 2026: GAAP revenue USD 19,345 million, operating income USD 6,728 million, net income available to common shareholders USD 4,679 million, and diluted EPS USD 1.56.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, three months ended August 31, 2026

claims.text: Q1 operating cash flow of USD 23,103 million included USD 11,363 million of customer prepayments with a significant financing component. Cash capex was USD 28,499 million; net ATM equity proceeds were USD 19,909 million. Interpretation: cash generation must be assessed alongside prepayment financing and dilution.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows

claims.text: The September 25 proxy lists Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia as CEOs, Hilary Maxson as CFO, and Safra Catz as executive vice chair. This supersedes older descriptions naming Catz as CEO.

evidence.locator: Proxy summary / fiscal 2026 named executive officers

valuation-context.unavailable: No current market price or forward consensus was sourced. Valuation needs diluted common equity, preferred claims, debt, leases, and funding commitments reconciled before any enterprise-value multiple.

catalysts.unavailable: A verified date for the next earnings release was not obtained. Monitor subsequent filings for capacity conversion, customer prepayments, cash capex, and funding changes.

claims.text: Interpretation: delayed capacity, weak conversion of commitments to revenue, or continued cash demands beyond accessible funding would challenge the cloud thesis. Large prepayments do not remove execution obligations.

evidence.locator: MD&A, Liquidity and Capital Resources; cash flows

claims.text: Bull: delivered capacity converts demand profitably. Base: expansion consumes capital before returns mature. Bear: demand or utilization disappoints while commitments persist. These are assumptions; customer concentration and contract financing require deeper review.

evidence.locator: Remaining Performance Obligations; Capital Investment Program

claims.text: The September earnings release explicitly positions Oracle AI Data Platform against Palantir-style enterprise ontologies. This is Oracle marketing positioning, not independent proof of superior capability or a commercial partnership.

evidence.locator: New Oracle AI Data Platform Automatically Generates Enterprise Ontology

claims.text: September 12, 2026: Oracle announced Larry Ellison cancelled his stock-sale plan, with no sales under that plan before cancellation. The September 14 filing documents the event; cancellation is not an insider purchase.

gaps: Evidence cutoff 2026-10-18; latest financial period verified is 2026-08-31. SEC submissions and selected issuer releases were reviewed, not all intervening product or legal news.
No current valuation or complete debt, preferred-stock, lease, customer-concentration, and contract-funding model.
